entities.summary: Roman Gotsiridze is a Georgian economist and politician. He served as a member of Parliament in 1990–1992, 1992, 2004–2005, and 2016–2024, as well as Deputy Prime Minister in 1992–1993 and President of the National Bank of Georgia in 2005–2007.
